Choose from Midwest Automotive Designs Patriot – Patriot Cruiser – Forest River OGV V RV – V Cruise – Thor Motor Coach Tranquility – Entegra Coach Launch and more. We also buy and sell quality pre-owned models such as Airstream Interstate – Atlas – Jayco Terrain – Tiffin GH1 – Winnebago Revel – Adventure Wagon – Pleasure Way Plateau – Ascent – Roadtrek – Leisure Travel Wonder – Unity - Coachmen Galleria – Thor Sanctuary and much more. Visit MHSRV.com for our complete line-up and the sale prices that have made us the #1 volume selling motor home dealership in the world 13 years in a row! About This RV This luxury Class B RV measures approximately 24' 2' in length with the 170EXT sprinter chassis and all the features that come along with it such as the 2.0L High-Output Diesel engine, keyless start, Mercedes Pro Connect, Suburban water heater, induction cooktop, custom Maybach style seating, side & rear screen doors, dark tinted side & rear windows, fiberglass running boards, power awning with LED lights and so much more. Designed for explorers who demand both off-road capability and first-class comfort, the MD2 now comes packed with innovative features that redefine the Class B experience. For 2027 the patriot received Crafted curves and Ambient light for a re-imagined interior which includes new radius overhead side cabinets built in-house through their 19-step wood process. With the changed interior there is new full power luxury furniture, built in-house in their custom sewing department. Each piece of furniture in the 2027 Patriot is handcrafted at their Elkhart facility. The Patriot also offers the best-in-class hybrid off-grid power system with a 1080Ah lithium battery which is 4x larger than their 2026 standard. With this new upgrade there is a clean-burning, quiet Onan 2.5KW propane generator in a hybrid system that delivers best-in-class off-grid capability. Solar, alternator, shoreline, and generator all work together to keep you out longer. Upgrade to the Freedom 1620Ah package with 340W solar and a 280A secondary alternator to go fully generator-free. Starlink satellite internet comes standard and pairs with the new Firefly Eclipse module, giving you full coach control from your phone over a cellular signal. Monitor and adjust climate, lighting, tanks, and more from miles away. Perfect for pet owners who want peace of mind knowing their furry co-pilots are comfortable while they're out exploring. For the first time ever, the driver and passenger get the same premium audio experience as rear passengers. The 2027 replaces the factory Mercedes front cabin speakers with upgraded Alpine speakers complemented by a Fusion Radio and designated Alpine subwoofer throughout. Every seat in the coach is now a great seat to listen from. The 2027 Patriot is built around a best-in-class utility package standard on every coach. The new Shower Miser water-saving system extends your fresh water tank so you stay out longer. The power macerator pump with power gate valves makes black and grey tank management effortless. The Gree 15,000 BTU heat pump keeps the cabin cool in summer and warm in shoulder seasons, while the Timberline diesel furnace and tankless hot water heater deliver instant, reliable heat and on-demand hot water in any conditions. At Motor Home Specialist, we DO NOT charge any prep or orientation fees like you will find at other dealerships. All sale prices include a multi-point inspection, interior & exterior wash, detail service and a fully automated high-pressure rain booth test and coach wash that is a standout service unlike that of any other in the industry. You will also receive a thorough coach orientation with an MHSRV technician, a night stay in our delivery park featuring landscaped and covered pads with full hook-ups and much more!
